old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-icn7","title":"Process and persist the detached verified DAO snapshot","description":"P1 security/correctness: DaoOriginValidator.validate() authenticates a detached reparse of _exact_received_dao_wire(), but DaoManager._apply_dao_at_unlocked() then performs semantic parsing, target checks, route mutation, and replay-floor digesting on the caller-owned original DAO. The manager lock does not protect that object, so another thread/callback holding it can mutate fields/options after provenance validation and before _extract_updates()/dao.to_bytes(); unsigned semantics can then be installed and the persisted digest need not describe the verified wire. process_dao_at() also builds an ACK from the mutable original after releasing the manager lock. Make successful validation return/retain the immutable exact signed bytes plus a detached parsed DAO, and use only that snapshot for all semantics, digest commit (origin_result.dao_digest), and ACK fields. Add a deterministic mutation-race regression proving no unsigned route/ACK state is accepted.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T15:48:47.31293Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T15:48:47.31293Z"}

new_value: Already fixed in current codebase. The code uses provenance-based TOCTOU protection: (1) _exact_received_dao_wire() validates structural state unchanged (2) validate_and_process_dao_at creates snapshot from provenance bytes (3) _apply_dao_at_unlocked rebinds dao=DAO.from_bytes(origin_result.signed_dao_bytes) after validation. Added regression tests: test_mutation_invalidates_provenance (verifies mutation fails safely) and test_unmutated_dao_uses_provenance (verifies happy path). All 66 dao_origin tests pass.
